Package com.kerosene.kfe.paymentrequest.domain.model

Class KfePaymentBehaviorContract

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.paymentrequest.domain.model.KfePaymentBehaviorContract
public class KfePaymentBehaviorContract extends Object
Service-level contract that documents and enforces payment request behavior. Acts as a configuration snapshot per payment request — immutable after creation.

Each persisted payment request carries one instance of this contract, serialized as a JSON column (behavior_contract) for auditability.

      public KfePaymentBehaviorContract()

    • KfePaymentBehaviorContract

      public KfePaymentBehaviorContract(KfePaymentBehaviorContract.LinkType linkType, KfePaymentBehaviorContract.PartialPaymentPolicy partialPaymentPolicy, KfePaymentBehaviorContract.OverpaymentPolicy overpaymentPolicy, KfePaymentBehaviorContract.ExpiredPaymentPolicy expiredPaymentPolicy)

  • Method Details

    • forFixedAmount

      public static KfePaymentBehaviorContract forFixedAmount()
      Default contract for fixed-amount payment links. SINGLE_USE, REJECT partial, CREDIT_FULL overpayment, REJECT after expiry.
      Returns:
      a new fixed-amount behavior snapshot intended to remain unchanged after request creation

    • forOpenAmount

      public static KfePaymentBehaviorContract forOpenAmount()
      Default contract for open-amount payment links. SINGLE_USE, ACCEPT_AND_TRACK partials, CREDIT_FULL overpayment, ACCEPT_WITHIN_GRACE_PERIOD for expiry.
      Returns:
      a new open-amount behavior snapshot

    • forReusable

      public static KfePaymentBehaviorContract forReusable()
      Default contract for reusable payment links (e.g., tip jars, donation pages). REUSABLE, ACCEPT_AND_TRACK partials, CREDIT_FULL overpayment, ALWAYS_ACCEPT_IF_CONFIRMED for expiry.
      Returns:
      a new reusable-link behavior snapshot
